purpose: Public-claim gate for the v1.1 evidence corpus. Establishes which statements may be made publicly and which are explicitly not claimed. Supersedes the v1.0 public security claims decision (see supersession-map entry PUBLIC-SECURITY-CLAIMS-DECISION, state HISTORICAL_ONLY). The gate governs the global V1.1 baseline (scope sandbox_ci, incl. the L1/L2/Traffic frozen-green baselines); China-market evidence remains in scope as a subordinate capability.

rules.subject: capability_status
rules.rule: Public pages and docs must only assert a capability status that matches the v1.1 manifest proof_status vocabulary (victory_locked, proven_sandbox, proven_staging, proven_production, implementation_present, architectural_commitment, planned, blocked, not_claimed).

rules.subject: forbidden_status
rules.rule: No assertion of certified, authorized, compliant, satisfied, or guaranteed status for any security, compliance, or regulatory property.

rules.subject: provider_packs
rules.rule: Antom/Alipay and WeChat Pay provider Packs are IN DEVELOPMENT; UnionPay is PLANNED. No generally-available or production claim for any provider Pack.

rules.subject: aws
rules.rule: No AWS program acceptance, provider partnership, mainland-China deployment, or provider logo claim is permitted.

rules.subject: payload_locality
rules.rule: Payload locality is an architectural commitment and must not be weakened with 'where possible' or 'best effort' qualifiers.

rules.subject: evidence_level
rules.rule: Evidence level claims must match the manifest evidence_level vocabulary (CODE_INSPECTION, UNIT_TEST, INTEGRATION_TEST, E2E_TEST, SANDBOX_CI, STAGING_VALIDATED, PRODUCTION_LIVE).

rules.subject: contact
rules.rule: Public contact must use the approved channel (mailto:zen@zen-mesh.io). No alternative contact surfaces.

rules.subject: traffic_frozen_claims
rules.rule: Traffic frozen-baseline claims must stay bounded to the declared frozen pre-cloud candidate and its counted qualification scope. Durable acceptance must not be translated into exactly-once, guaranteed delivery, global loss-free, or production-proven durability claims. HA false-acceptance refusal must not be generalized beyond the tested topology. Counted qualification may state only exact declared scenario counts proven by source artifacts.

rules.subject: frozen_vs_current
rules.rule: Evidence that participates in a frozen layer must not inherit FROZEN status. Only victory_locked entries with a canonical freeze artifact are immutable; sandbox-proven entries are verified-current and expected to evolve. Absence of evidence is UNKNOWN, NOT_PROVEN, or NOT_CLAIMED — never implicitly satisfied.

rules.subject: superseded_evidence
rules.rule: No public surface may present a SUPERSEDED, HISTORICAL_ONLY, or INVALIDATED artifact as current authority. Current authority is defined by the v1.1 manifest and supersession-map current_baseline only.
